approval_evidence.quote: Initial U.S. Approval: 2006 (Januvia (sitagliptin) tablets, NDA 021995; Drugs@FDA/openFDA lists the original approval dated 2006-10-16)

search_log: 2006Q3 (0.6) is the prior-year column of the third-quarter 2007 10-Q; the October 2006 release says Januvia 'has already launched in Mexico' ahead of the 16 Oct 2006 U.S. approval; Merck's own 2006 documents print no Januvia sales line for that quarter

2006Q4, 2007Q4 and 2008Q4 are stated in the text of the quarter's earnings release (the sales summary tables of those releases have no Januvia line); 2007Q1-Q3, 2008Q1-Q3 and 2009Q1-Q3 are read from the legacy Merck 10-Qs (CIK 64978), which print Januvia to a tenth of a million
2009Q4 and 2010 quarters are read from the earnings release tables printed after the Merck/Schering-Plough merger (GAAP column; the adjustment column is blank for Januvia)
2014Q3: the quarter's own release prints only a combined 'Januvia / Janumet' line (1,439), so the Januvia-only figure is read from the fourth-quarter 2014 release's 2014 quarterly columns
from 2011 the earnings summary table headlines 'JANUVIA/JANUMET' combined; the series uses the separate 'Januvia' line of the detailed sales table, never the combined headline

sum of the four quarters equals the printed full year for 2011-2020, 2022 and 2024, and differs by 1 (rounding) in 2021, 2023 and 2025; 2010 quarters sum to 2,386 against a printed 2,385; 2009 quarters sum to 1,922.2 against 1,922

listed Merck & Co. (CIK 310158) filings via data.sec.gov submissions (recent plus every filings.files page), all forms, then kept 8-K and 8-K/A with item 2.02 and 10-Q/10-K. No 8-K/A lists item 2.02 (8-K/As 2006-2026 list only items 9.01, 7.01, 5.07 or 5.02); the 2019-02-01 8-K/A, filed the day of the Q4 2018 results, contains only an exhibit 99.2

legacy Merck registrant (CIK 64978, which before the November 2009 merger with Schering-Plough was a separate filer; CIK 310158 was Schering-Plough until then) listed the same way for 2006-2009 earnings releases and 10-Qs
downloaded the EX-99.1 of every item 2.02 8-K from 2006 to 2026-08-04 (85 releases); two item 2.02 filings (2013-02-19, 2022-04-21) are not quarterly results releases and carry no product line
read the product rows with scripts/build.py (HTML table rows, same row reading as the verifier) and cross-checked each quarter against the prior-year column of the following year's release
